item.title: Arctic infrastructure was built on frozen ground—drones and digital twins can help spot the permafrost thaw coming
item.description: From the air, Wainwright, Alaska, looks like a perfectly stable band of homes and roads between the Chukchi Sea and a vast, flat tundra. Fuente: Phys.org.
